title: The Shadow
narration: In twenty nineteen, the Event Horizon Telescope released the first direct image of a black hole — M87*, a supermassive beast with a mass of billions of Suns.
visual_goal: First-ever black hole image, then zoom into the dark center

title: The Frozen Edge
narration: Look closer at that orange ring. That's the event horizon — the point where escape velocity equals the speed of light.
visual_goal: Object stretching and freezing at the horizon, time distortion visual
search_queries: black hole event horizon time dilation

title: The Ripple
narration: In twenty fifteen, we heard a chirp — barely a second long. But it was the sound of two black holes.
visual_goal: Gravitational wave animation, two spiraling black holes merging

title: The Infant Giant
narration: Then there's UHZ1 — a supermassive black hole seen just four hundred seventy million years after the Big Bang. The universe was only about three% of its current age.
visual_goal: Early universe, bright quasar in dark space, distant galaxies

title: The Question
narration: A century ago, Schwarzschild's solution to Einstein's equations predicted them. In nineteen sixty-seven, John Wheeler gave them a name: black holes. In twenty fifteen, we heard them collide.
visual_goal: Timeline of milestones, then final black hole silhouette against stars
